rows.s_sql:
SET	@prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_harm10(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  result1_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	result1_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  result2_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	result2_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  result3_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	result3_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  result4_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	result4_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  result5_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	result5_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  result6_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	result6_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  result7_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	result7_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
   PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode)
	) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_harm10 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_harm10
(
SELECT
@id,h.hoscode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f11 in(1) AND t.g2 in(1)  , p.cid,NULL)) result1_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f12 in(1) AND t.g2 IN(1), p.cid,NULL)) result1_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f11 in(1) AND t.g3 in(1)  , p.cid,NULL)) result1_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f12 in(1) AND t.g3 IN(1), p.cid,NULL)) result1_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f11 in(1) AND t.g4 in(1)  , p.cid,NULL)) result1_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f12 in(1) AND t.g4 IN(1), p.cid,NULL)) result1_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f11 in(1) AND t.g5 in(1)  , p.cid,NULL)) result1_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f12 in(1) AND t.g5 IN(1), p.cid,NULL)) result1_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f11 in(1) AND t.g6 in(1)  , p.cid,NULL)) result1_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f12 in(1) AND t.g6 IN(1), p.cid,NULL)) result1_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f11 in(1) AND t.g7 in(1)  , p.cid,NULL)) result1_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f12 in(1) AND t.g7 IN(1), p.cid,NULL)) result1_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f11 in(1) AND t.g8 in(1)  , p.cid,NULL)) result1_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.f12 in(1) AND t.g8 IN(1), p.cid,NULL)) result1_2
FROM t_harm t INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON t.cid=p.CID
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
WHERE p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9) AND p.NATION in(99)
 AND (t.g1+t.g2+t.g3+t.g4+t.g5+t.g6+t.g7+t.g8)>0
GROUP BY h.hoscode);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("result1_1") as "result1_1" ,SUM("result1_2") as "result1_2" ,SUM("result2_1") as "result2_1" ,SUM("result2_2") as "result2_2" ,SUM("result3_1") as "result3_1" ,SUM("result3_2") as "result3_2" ,SUM("result4_1") as "result4_1" ,SUM("result4_2") as "result4_2" ,SUM("result5_1") as "result5_1" ,SUM("result5_2") as "result5_2" ,SUM("result6_1") as "result6_1" ,SUM("result6_2") as "result6_2" ,SUM("result7_1") as "result7_1" ,SUM("result7_2") as "result7_2"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name ,  SUM(result1_1) as result1_1 ,SUM(result1_2) as result1_2 ,SUM(result2_1) as result2_1 ,SUM(result2_2) as result2_2 ,SUM(result3_1) as result3_1 ,SUM(result3_2) as result3_2 ,SUM(result4_1) as result4_1 ,SUM(result4_2) as result4_2 ,SUM(result5_1) as result5_1 ,SUM(result5_2) as result5_2 ,SUM(result6_1) as result6_1 ,SUM(result6_2) as result6_2 ,SUM(result7_1) as result7_1 ,SUM(result7_2) as result7_2  FROM chospital as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1
